title: Who Stole the Sun?
description: A pocket detective notebook: six towns, six missing miniature suns. Read the exhibits, cross-check the timelines, mark your board, then name the culprit, the scene and the decisive exhibit before the judge. Six hand-written cases of rising difficulty, each with a unique solution and a full step-by-step explanation. EN/FR/ES.
controls: Click or tap: read exhibits, mark your board, make an accusation
Works with mouse, touch and keyboard
